rules: No full-screen gradients. Use pure blacks and dark grays.
Use text shadow where needed to meet accessibility contrast ratios.
No transparent background in header. Use solid #050505 or crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).

mono.styles: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs for diamond specifications and overlines

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise/grain overlay on the entire body (opacity-30, pointer-events-none, mix-blend-overlay) to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 on cards and structural elements.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating headers and sticky elements (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, 1px top border). Solid dark backgrounds for catalog cards.
visual_enhancers.imagery: Spotlight effect on diamonds. Images should have low-opacity black overlays (bg-black/30) if text sits on top, or text should avoid overlapping the focal point.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Containers with borders must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Kinetic masked text reveal (line-by-line). Central clipped diamond image with subtle scale-in animation.
layouts.manifesto: Bento grid (Tetris Grid style) or overlapping sticky sections. Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) in large thin serif.
layouts.catalog: High-density Grid for results (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4. Sidebar for filters.
layouts.detail_view: 50/50 split layout. Left side: Sticky massive image of diamond. Right side: Scrolling specs, description, and Quote form.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal: animate y from '100%' to '0%' inside an overflow-hidden wrapper.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons have subtle scale (active:scale-95). Catalog cards reveal a subtle border glow or slight y-translate on hover. Staggered entrance for catalog items.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, smooth drift. Massive outline text or small editorial ribbon with diamond separators (✦).

components.header: Sticky nav, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60. Logo left, Links center, 'Login / Register' button right.

hero.instruction: Wrap each line of the H1 in a span with overflow-hidden, and the inner span animates y: 100% -> 0. Dark background, large diamond image.

manifesto_chapters.instruction: Use sticky positioning for a stacked card effect, or a sweeping horizontal scroll using framer-motion useScroll.

editorial_marquee.instruction: Thin serif text 'SHREE DIAMOND EXPORTS ✦ BEYOND BRILLIANCE ✦' moving very slowly.

catalog_filters.instruction: Use shadcn accordion for filter groups (Shape, Carat, Cut, Color, Clarity). Checkboxes for selection.

diamond_card.instruction: No traditional 'Card' look. Use flat div with 1px border-white/10. Large image. Mono font for stats (E.g., '1.02 CT • VVS1 • D').

auth_modal_or_page.instruction: Pure black/white high contrast forms. Strip Vercel look. Sharp corners (rounded-none).

enquiry_form.instruction: For the detail page. Input fields with border-b only (underlined inputs) for a luxurious editorial feel, or sharp 1px bordered inputs.

hero.description: A striking diamond on a black background with a reflection. Perfect for the hero spotlight.

manifesto_1.description: Diamonds sitting on crushed glass. Represents raw potential and craftsmanship.

manifesto_2.description: Blue and white diamond pattern. Represents clarity and structure.

catalog_placeholder.description: Diamond rings for catalog fallback or category images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, filter checkboxes, diamond cards, login forms) MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact color palette (Deep Obsidian/Black theme). No bright blue generic SaaS colors.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root App level.
For the kinetic hero, use Framer Motion. Split the heading into words or lines, and animate the 'y' property from 100% to 0% within an overflow-hidden wrapper.
Use Lucide React for icons, keeping them minimal and elegant (stroke-width 1 or 1.5).
In the Catalog section, build a Sidebar for filters and a main grid for Diamond Cards.
Diamond Cards must look premium: sharp corners, thin 1px borders, lots of negative space, using Monospace font for technical specs (Carat, Color, Clarity).
The login/register flow should blur the catalog prices until the user is authenticated. Show 'Login to view price' placeholder.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Accordion, Forms, Inputs, Buttons) are customized to remove their default generic rounded look. Use 'rounded-none' or max 'rounded-sm'.
Do not use text-center universally. Align text left for better readability, especially in the manifesto and catalog.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles relevant to the app style (sharp edges for luxury).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
